title: Set data quality and trust measures
summary: If people do not trust the data, they will not use it. Agree what good quality means and how you will show it.

beginner: Agree what quality means for your users: accuracy, completeness, freshness and consistency.
Set measurable targets for each, such as 'updated by 8am daily'.
Decide how you will check them automatically.
Show users when data was last updated and any known issues.
Agree who fixes problems and how fast.
experienced: Publish data contracts between producers and consumers.
Track trust through user feedback and usage.
Report data quality as a product health measure.

toolExamples.looker: Show freshness and quality status on each dashboard.
toolExamples.power-bi: Add a data quality page to the report.

pitfalls: Users finding errors before you do
